notes: Entry: minimum five Cs including English at SPM, IGCSE or equivalent.
Certification: School Curriculum & Standards Authority (SCSA), Western Australia, under WACE. Assessment: 50% school-based and 50% external examination.

Students typically study five subjects. Group A: English as an Additional Language, Mathematics Application, Chemistry, Physics, Human Biology. Group B: English as an Additional Language, Mathematics Application, Business Management & Enterprise, Economics, Psychology.
Support: academic feedback, examination preparation, university application guidance, study skills, wellbeing, leadership and co-curricular activities.

terms: Payment column order: Sem (1) Sem (2) S Sem (3) Sem (4) Sem (5) S Sem (6) Sem (7) Sem (8) S Sem (9) Total; Academic Period / Start Jul-26 Dec-26 May-27 Jul-27 Dec-27 May-28 Jul-28 Dec-28 May-29
A source dash is retained as “-”; it is not converted into zero.
1) Sem - Semester (June, October/November) / S Sem - Short Semester (March).

2) The initial or advance payment of RM27,000 for Postgraduate programmes (Doctor of Philosophy and Master Programme) shall be made after the student has fulfilled all admission requirements and has received official confirmation of acceptance to enroll at KLUST. This amount shall apply to students from the Global South and ASEAN countries, whereas an initial payment of RM30,000 shall apply to students from other countries. Any shortfall or outstanding balance for Semesters 2 and 3 shall be settled in full on a semester basis. This payment arrangement shall likewise apply to each subsequent semester until the student has successfully completed the programme.
3) The total Semester fees are due upon registration. These fees are non-refundable, unless otherwise stated.

4) 60% of the Tuition Fee is refundable by submitting the "Withdrawal Form" within fourteen (14) days from the 1st day of Registration at each intake. 80% of the Tuition Fee will be refunded if the student withdraws before the 1st day of Registration. In both cases, the withdrawal must be approved by the Management.
5) Tuition Fee is based on the number of standard credit hours registered (Bachelor & Diploma Programmes) for each semester.

6) Students who do not fulfill the English language requirement are REQUIRED to enroll in the Intensive English Programme (IEP). A fee of RM4,000 will be imposed on students who fail to register for the IEP as required. This policy applies even to students who have not met the English proficiency requirement but have obtained English qualifications from external institutions or language centers. Students who arrive in Malaysia and obtain their visa under KLUST are also bound by this requirement.
Payment methods: official university online/student portal, card, e-wallet, bank draft or transfer. Obtain payment instructions through the official application process.

8) Processing Fee is inclusive of i-Kad, Medical Insurance, Visa Processing and Medical Examination and is applicable to all international students. This fee is cover for 1 year and it is non- refundable. Processing Fee is chargeable once the completed application form is submitted to KLUST. For students who wishes to process his/her own visa directly to EMGS are required to make a processing fee of approximately of RM1,580 to KLUST. As for the KLUST progression students, the Processing Fee is RM2,500.
9) The renewal of i-Kad, Medical Insurance, Visa Processing and Medical Examination will be charged when it is due.
10) The Student Pass/Visa cancellation fee of RM100 is applicable when the student complete their studies or withdraw from KLUST.
11) Replacement of iKad due to damage or loss will be charged according to Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS) rate.
12) International Student Administrative Fee is chargeable to all international students who arrive with e-VAL (Visa Approval Letter).

13) Students are required to pay semester fees in FULL. Any outstanding balance due must be fully settled. Failure to do so will result in the student being prohibited from registering for a new semester, obtaining the examination slip accessing the examination result.

14) Caution Fee may only be refunded by application after a student has completed or withdrawn from his/her programme of study. The application for the refund shall be made within 3 months from the date of completion or withdrawal from the university.

15) KLUST will refund the Caution fee only after the student completes the Deposit Claim form or Withdrawal form and it is refundable within sixty (60) days upon submission of respective forms to the Bursary Department. KLUST reserves the right to recover any outstanding amount owed by a student and will utilise the caution fee for partial or full settlement of any outstanding amount. (Please refer to Refund Policy)
16) All the settlement of fee must be in Ringgit Malaysia (RM) at the prevailing rate.
17) Effective 1 September 2025 : Private Education Services are subject to service tax 6% for non-Malaysian citizens in accordance with the Service Tax Regulations 2025.
18) Official Receipt is issued upon payment. Additional request for copy(ies) of receipt(s) will not be entertained.
19) If you need further clarifications, please email to bursary@klust.edu.my.

20) This fee structure shall take effect from 12 December 2025 and subject to change at anytime without prior notice. The information stated in this schedule is correct at the time of printing as at 15 May 2026.

This amount shall apply to students from the Global South and ASEAN countries, whereas an initial payment of RM30,000 shall apply to students from other countries. Any shortfall or outstanding balance for Semesters 2 and 3 shall be settled in full on a semester basis. This payment arrangement shall likewise apply to each subsequent semester until the student has successfully completed the programme.
3) The total Semester fees are due upon registration. These fees are non-refundable, unless otherwise stated.

4) 60% of the Tuition Fee is refundable by submitting the "Withdrawal Form" within fourteen (14) days from the 1st day of Registration at each intake. 80% of the Tuition Fee will be refunded if the student withdraws before the 1st day of Registration. In both cases, the withdrawal must be approved by the Management.
5) Tuition Fee is based on the number of standard credit hours registered (Bachelor & Diploma Programmes) for each semester.

6) Students who do not fulfill the English language requirement are REQUIRED to enroll in the Intensive English Programme (IEP). A fee of RM4,000 will be imposed on students who fail to register for the IEP as required. This policy applies even to students who have not met the English proficiency requirement but have obtained English qualifications from external institutions or language centers. Students who arrive in Malaysia and obtain their visa under KLUST are also bound by this requirement.
Payment methods: official university online/student portal, card, e-wallet, bank draft or transfer. Obtain payment instructions through the official application process.

8) Processing Fee is inclusive of i-Kad, Medical Insurance, Visa Processing and Medical Examination and is applicable to all international students. This fee is cover for 1 year and it is non- refundable. Processing Fee is chargeable once the completed application form is submitted to KLUST. 12) International Student Administrative Fee is chargeable to all international students who arrive with e-VAL (Visa Approval Letter).

14) Caution Fee may only be refunded by application after a student has completed or withdrawn from his/her programme of study. The application for the refund shall be made within 3 months from the date of completion or withdrawal from the university.

15) KLUST will refund the Caution fee only after the student completes the Deposit Claim form or Withdrawal form and it is refundable within sixty (60) days upon submission of respective forms to the Bursary Department. Kuala Lumpur University of Science and Technology (KLUST) — international fee schedule

tables.caption: Printed semester / level fee schedule (MYR / RM)
rows: Academic Period / Start Jul-26 Dec-26 May-27 Jul 26
TOTAL SEMESTER FEES NOT SUBJECT TO SST (RM)

terms: Payment column order: SEMESTER (Sem ) Sem (1) Sem (2) Sem (3) Total; Academic Period / Start Jul-26 Dec-26 May-27 Jul 26 - Nov 26
A source dash is retained as “-”; it is not converted into zero.
1) Sem - Semester (June, October/November) / S Sem - Short Semester (March).

2) The initial or advance payment of RM27,000 for Postgraduate programmes (Doctor of Philosophy and Master Programme) shall be made after the student has fulfilled all admission requirements and has received official confirmation of acceptance to enroll at KLUST. This amount shall apply to students from the Global South and ASEAN countries, whereas an initial payment of RM30,000 shall apply to students from other countries. Any shortfall or outstanding balance for Semesters 2 and 3 shall be settled in full on a semester basis. This payment arrangement shall likewise apply to each subsequent semester until the student has successfully completed the programme.
3) The total Semester fees are due upon registration. These fees are non-refundable, unless otherwise stated.

4) 60% of the Tuition Fee is refundable by submitting the "Withdrawal Form" within fourteen (14) days from the 1st day of Registration at each intake. 80% of the Tuition Fee will be refunded if the student withdraws before the 1st day of Registration. In both cases, the withdrawal must be approved by the Management.
5) Tuition Fee is based on the number of standard credit hours registered (Bachelor & Diploma Programmes) for each semester.

6) Students who do not fulfill the English language requirement are REQUIRED to enroll in the Intensive English Programme (IEP). A fee of RM4,000 will be imposed on students who fail to register for the IEP as required. This policy applies even to students who have not met the English proficiency requirement but have obtained English qualifications from external institutions or language centers. Students who arrive in Malaysia and obtain their visa under KLUST are also bound by this requirement.
Payment methods: official university online/student portal, card, e-wallet, bank draft or transfer. Obtain payment instructions through the official application process.

8) Processing Fee is inclusive of i-Kad, Medical Insurance, Visa Processing and Medical Examination and is applicable to all international students. This fee is cover for 1 year and it is non-refundable. Processing Fee is chargeable once the completed application form is submitted to KLUST. For students who wishes to process his/her own visa directly to EMGS are required to make a processing fee of approximately of RM1,580 to KLUST. As for the KLUST progression students, the Processing Fee is RM2,500.
9) The renewal of i-Kad, Medical Insurance, Visa Processing and Medical Examination will be charged when it is due.
10) The Student Pass/Visa cancellation fee of RM100 is applicable when the student complete their studies or withdraw from KLUST.
11) Replacement of iKad due to damage or loss will be charged according to Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS) rate.
12) International Student Administrative Fee is chargeable to all international students who arrive with e-VAL (Visa Approval Letter).

13) Students are required to pay semester fees in FULL. Any outstanding balance due must be fully settled. Failure to do so will result in the student being prohibited from registering for a new semester, obtaining the examination slip accessing the examination result.

14) Caution Fee may only be refunded by application after a student has completed or withdrawn from his/her programme of study. The application for the refund shall be made within 3 months from the date of completion or withdrawal from the university.

15) KLUST will refund the Caution fee only after the student completes the Deposit Claim form or Withdrawal form and it is refundable within sixty (60) days upon submission of respective forms to the Bursary Department. KLUST reserves the right to recover any outstanding amount owed by a student and will utilise the caution fee for partial or full settlement of any outstanding amount. (Please refer to Refund Policy)
16) All the settlement of fee must be in Ringgit Malaysia (RM) at the prevailing rate.
17) Effective 1 September 2025 : Private Education Services are subject to service tax 6% for non-Malaysian citizens in accordance with the Service Tax Regulations 2025.
18) Official Receipt is issued upon payment. Additional request for copy(ies) of receipt(s) will not be entertained.
19) If you need further clarifications, please email to bursary@klust.edu.my.

20) This fee structure shall take effect from 12 December 2025 and subject to change at anytime without prior notice. The information stated in this schedule is correct at the time of printing as at 10 May 2026.

tables.caption: Printed semester / level fee schedule (MYR / RM)

terms: Payment column order: Sem (1) Sem (2) S Sem (3) Sem (4) Sem (5) S Sem (6) Sem (7) Sem (8) S Sem (9) Total; Academic Period / Start Jul-26 Dec-26 May-27 Jul-27 Dec-27 May-28 Jul-28 Dec-28 May-29
A source dash is retained as “-”; it is not converted into zero.
1) Sem - Semester (June, October/November) / S Sem - Short Semester (March).

2) The initial or advance payment of RM27,000 for Postgraduate programmes (Doctor of Philosophy and Master Programme) shall be made after the student has fulfilled all admission requirements and has received official confirmation of acceptance to enroll at KLUST. This amount shall apply to students from the Global South and ASEAN countries, whereas an initial payment of RM30,000 shall apply to students from other countries. Any shortfall or outstanding balance for Semesters 2 and 3 shall be settled in full on a semester basis. This payment arrangement shall likewise apply to each subsequent semester until the student has successfully completed the programme.
3) The total Semester fees are due upon registration. These fees are non-refundable, unless otherwise stated.

4) 60% of the Tuition Fee is refundable by submitting the "Withdrawal Form" within fourteen (14) days from the 1st day of Registration at each intake. 80% of the Tuition Fee will be refunded if the student withdraws before the 1st day of Registration. In both cases, the withdrawal must be approved by the Management.
5) Tuition Fee is based on the number of standard credit hours registered (Bachelor & Diploma Programmes) for each semester.

6) Students who do not fulfill the English language requirement are REQUIRED to enroll in the Intensive English Programme (IEP). A fee of RM4,000 will be imposed on students who fail to register for the IEP as required. This policy applies even to students who have not met the English proficiency requirement but have obtained English qualifications from external institutions or language centers. Students who arrive in Malaysia and obtain their visa under KLUST are also bound by this requirement.
Payment methods: official university online/student portal, card, e-wallet, bank draft or transfer. Obtain payment instructions through the official application process.

8) Processing Fee is inclusive of i-Kad, Medical Insurance, Visa Processing and Medical Examination and is applicable to all international students. This fee is cover for 1 year and it is non- refundable. Processing Fee is chargeable once the completed application form is submitted to KLUST. For students who wishes to process his/her own visa directly to EMGS are required to make a processing fee of approximately of RM1,580 to KLUST. As for the KLUST progression students, the Processing Fee is RM2,500.
9) The renewal of i-Kad, Medical Insurance, Visa Processing and Medical Examination will be charged when it is due.
10) The Student Pass/Visa cancellation fee of RM100 is applicable when the student complete their studies or withdraw from KLUST.
11) Replacement of iKad due to damage or loss will be charged according to Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS) rate.
12) International Student Administrative Fee is chargeable to all international students who arrive with e-VAL (Visa Approval Letter).

13) Students are required to pay semester fees in FULL. Any outstanding balance due must be fully settled. Failure to do so will result in the student being prohibited from registering for a new semester, obtaining the examination slip accessing the examination result.

14) Caution Fee may only be refunded by application after a student has completed or withdrawn from his/her programme of study. The application for the refund shall be made within 3 months from the date of completion or withdrawal from the university.

15) KLUST will refund the Caution fee only after the student completes the Deposit Claim form or Withdrawal form and it is refundable within sixty (60) days upon submission of respective forms to the Bursary Department. KLUST reserves the right to recover any outstanding amount owed by a student and will utilise the caution fee for partial or full settlement of any outstanding amount. (Please refer to Refund Policy)
16) All the settlement of fee must be in Ringgit Malaysia (RM) at the prevailing rate.
17) Effective 1 September 2025 : Private Education Services are subject to service tax 6% for non-Malaysian citizens in accordance with the Service Tax Regulations 2025.
18) Official Receipt is issued upon payment. Additional request for copy(ies) of receipt(s) will not be entertained.
19) If you need further clarifications, please email to bursary@klust.edu.my.

20) This fee structure shall take effect from 12 December 2025 and subject to change at anytime without prior notice. The information stated in this schedule is correct at the time of printing as at 10 May 2026.

2) The initial or advance payment of RM27,000 for Postgraduate programmes (Doctor of Philosophy and Master Programme) shall be made after the student has fulfilled all admission requirements and has received official confirmation of acceptance to enroll at KLUST. This amount shall apply to students from the Global South and ASEAN countries, whereas an initial payment of RM30,000 shall apply to students from other countries. Any shortfall or outstanding balance for Semesters 2 and 3 shall be settled in full on a semester basis. This payment arrangement shall likewise apply to each subsequent semester until the student has successfully completed the programme.
3) The total Semester fees are due upon registration. These fees are non-refundable, unless otherwise stated.

4) 60% of the Tuition Fee is refundable by submitting the "Withdrawal Form" within fourteen (14) days from the 1st day of Registration at each intake. 80% of the Tuition Fee will be refunded if the student withdraws before the 1st day of Registration. In both cases, the withdrawal must be approved by the Management.
5) Tuition Fee is based on the number of standard credit hours registered (Bachelor & Diploma Programmes) for each semester.

6) Students who do not fulfill the English language requirement are REQUIRED to enroll in the Intensive English Programme (IEP). A fee of RM4,000 will be imposed on students who fail to register for the IEP as required. This policy applies even to students who have not met the English proficiency requirement but have obtained English qualifications from external institutions or language centers. Students who arrive in Malaysia and obtain their visa under KLUST are also bound by this requirement.
Payment methods: official university online/student portal, card, e-wallet, bank draft or transfer. Obtain payment instructions through the official application process.

14) Caution Fee may only be refunded by application after a student has completed or withdrawn from his/her programme of study. The application for the refund shall be made within 3 months from the date of completion or withdrawal from the university.

15) KLUST will refund the Caution fee only after the student completes the Deposit Claim form or Withdrawal form and it is refundable within sixty (60) days upon submission of respective forms to the Bursary Department. KLUST reserves the right to recover any outstanding amount owed by a student and will utilise the caution fee for partial or full settlement of any outstanding amount. (Please refer to Refund Policy)
16) All the settlement of fee must be in Ringgit Malaysia (RM) at the prevailing rate.
17) Effective 1 September 2025 : Private Education Services are subject to service tax 6% for non-Malaysian citizens in accordance with the Service Tax Regulations 2025.
18) Official Receipt is issued upon payment. Additional request for copy(ies) of receipt(s) will not be entertained.

20) This fee structure shall take effect from 12 December 2025 and subject to change at anytime without prior notice. The information stated in this schedule is correct at the time of printing as at 10 May 2026.

schedules.label: 2026 — March to December fee schedule

refs.title: Goon Institution — fee and intake schedule

terms: Intakes 1 March 2026–31 December 2026.
All fees except security deposit are subject to 6% SST, effective 1 August 2025.
Once the course starts, fees are non-refundable except the security deposit after outstanding fees, damages or property losses are deducted.
Degree students are liable for partner-university fees on enrolment, even on withdrawal or termination.
Compulsory subjects must be completed unless credit-transfer exemptions apply.
Instalments are due before or at programme commencement and/or by the 7th of each month. Late penalty RM1 per day.
5% discount on net tuition only if paid in full before programme commencement.
Refund applications: within 60 days of exit stamp or parchment release (whichever is later) for graduates; within 60 days of official withdrawal/termination letter for others.
Semester tuition is indicative and depends on credits registered.
Printed GBP conversion basis is 6.5; exchange movements do not trigger further charges or refunds.
Bank commission for outstation cheques: 0.03% or RM0.50 minimum, whichever is higher.
Official payment methods include cheque, e-wallet, Visa/Mastercard, ATM card, transfer, Flywire or direct banking. Confirm instructions through the official application process.
Fees may be revised without notice. Awards and discounts have conditions and apply on a bottom-up basis.

rows: S Sem Sem RM3,570 RM7,130 RM53,490
Approximate total programme fee / printed payment terms

terms: Historical reference: effective 1 July 2025; printed 15 July 2025. Use the correct edition and student group; do not combine with 2026 amounts.
Approximate totals exclude processing fee and include 6% SST as printed.

Initial RM18,000 after admission confirmation, offset against registration and subsequent semesters; unused balance returned on completion or departure. MBA ODL follows acceptance-confirmation timing.
Tuition refund: 60% with an approved withdrawal form within 14 days after registration begins; 80% before registration begins.
Research programmes extending beyond the stated period incur RM2,000 per semester, up to 12 semesters for PhD, 9 for MSc Built Environment, and 8 for Master of Civil / Electronics Engineering.

Processing includes i-Kad, medical insurance, visa processing and medical exam for one year, non-refundable. Self-EMGS processing approx. RM1,580; progression students RM2,500. Renewal charged when due.
Student-pass cancellation on completion or withdrawal RM100; replacement iKad charged at EMGS rate.
Caution refund requires application within three months after completion/withdrawal. Refund within 60 days after claim/withdrawal forms, after deduction of outstanding amounts.
All settlement is in RM. Official receipt issued on payment; additional copies not entertained. Use official university payment instructions.
** marks a source accreditation claim for that edition; no current accreditation validity is inferred.

terms: 2026 fee schedule, subject to annual review (printed review note December 2025).
Payments use the quoted RM rates. USD figures are reference only at the printed RM4 = USD1 basis and may fluctuate.
Durations and total fees vary by intake; use the matching row. Recurring intake months in the 2026 source do not establish currently open admission.

Partner pathways have their own award and overseas-study conditions. University of the West of England 3+0 can be completed in Malaysia; UWE / Queensland University of Technology final-year pathways require UK / Australian study; Canterbury pathways require final-year study in New Zealand where marked.
No tax inclusion, entry requirement or scholarship amount is inferred where not specified.
